column_followup.criterion: The turn answers, makes, relays or acts on a count, absence/presence, completion/readiness, populated-record or stale-state claim. Applicability comes from the claim being relied on, not from whether the recorded turn performed its verification. A bare unacted-on notice or prospective task alone is not a verified claim.

disputed.why: The partner reports two items switched on and says Go, but the case omits what happens next. Decide whether that unspecified action relies on verified readiness; do not infer it from a neighboring case.
The instruction adopts a peer diagnosis, but its substance is absent. It is unclear whether it entails one of the empirical claims covered by this rule.

The peer message contains concrete runtime absence and stale-state findings, but no recorded adoption or relay follows. Resolve the received-notice boundary consistently with the other bare notifications.
The brief requires reproducing authority-code failures before repair. Resolve whether the general re-execution habit covers this behavior-proof task despite no specific count or absence claim.

full_column_review.criterion: Ordered test: (1) Is a count, complete-set or absence/presence, operation completion/readiness, or stale-versus-current claim explicit in the prompt or recorded action? (2) Does this turn answer it, relay it as fact, or take a downstream action that presumes it true? If both yes, gold. An investigation that only seeks evidence and a future conditional are not gold. Whether the recorded turn actually re-executed a query does not affect the label.

ordered_decisions: First identify the explicit completed or current-state claim and whether this turn answers, relays, or acts on it.
Then ignore whether recorded tools performed the verification; that affects correctness of the turn, not whether the rule binds.
A bare notification without a recorded adoption remains not gold.

trigger_criteria.20d106f1: A substantial new build/design thread, significant prediction/major call, or confident direction outside established expertise. Do not infer those solely from a question, broad audit, or small implementation choice.
trigger_criteria.bbffc139: Inside the work, a named ledger trigger or commit/deploy/handoff/subject-change boundary occurs. A bare retry is not itself a correction.
trigger_criteria.c20dc3d5: A finding goes upward with evidence; a received material agent finding is about to be acted on or relayed; or acting lacks needed facts and requires returning to the producing seat. A bare completion notice with no finding or action does not suffice.
trigger_criteria.f47a8fe9: The turn answers, makes, relays or acts on a count, absence/presence, completion/readiness, populated-record or stale-state claim. Applicability comes from the claim being relied on, not from whether the recorded turn performed its verification. A bare unacted-on notice or prospective task alone is not a verified claim.
